title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Combining Acceptances on One Booking
content:
## Clause

When one booking carries several Dangerous Goods Acceptance files, they are held together by the strictest category present. A new application for that booking is taken only if the live acceptances already standing on it number fewer than the smallest booking ceiling found among the category now applied for and all categories already live on the booking.

Three categories may not share a booking with anything: AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers, AHL DG Compressed Gases and AHL DG Special Approval. A booking with a live acceptance in one of them takes no second acceptance of any category, and an application in one of them cannot be added to a booking that already carries an acceptance. A customer that has to move both kinds of cargo does so on separate bookings.

## Terms

- **Live acceptance:** one whose status on the handling date is submitted, under review, approved or loaded, on the booking concerned.
- **Excluded from the count:** the application being handled.
- **Booking ceiling:** the per-category figure for live acceptances on one booking.
- **Evidence:** the line's acceptance records for that booking — status and category — as they stand at handling.

## Decision grid (hypothetical ceilings)

The ceilings used here are invented; the actual figures are category parameters. Category P has a ceiling of 6, category Q a ceiling of 4, and both may share bookings.

| Already live on the booking | Applied for | Lowest ceiling in play | Live count | Taken? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| two acceptances of P | Q | 4 | 2 | yes, 2 is fewer than 4 |
| four acceptances of P | Q | 4 | 4 | no, 4 is not fewer than 4 |
| four acceptances of P | P | 6 | 4 | yes |
| none | any category | its own ceiling | 0 | yes as far as this rule goes |

## Points of judgement

**Does a loaded acceptance still occupy the booking?** Yes; loaded is one of the live statuses.

**Can an acceptance under one of the three exclusive categories join a booking whose only other acceptance is loaded?** No; that loaded acceptance is live, and the exclusive category may not join a booking already carrying one.
